user.title: Add SteadyRoom
user.description: SteadyRoom controls an air conditioner from a room temperature sensor, so the unit makes fewer, real runs instead of short cycling. A new device starts as a test run: it sends nothing to the unit until you switch on Control the unit on the device page.

data_description.name: Name of the new thermostat device.
data_description.underlying: The real climate entity SteadyRoom sends mode and setpoint to.
data_description.room_sensor: Temperature in the middle of the room; SteadyRoom decides from this value.
data_description.fallback_sensor: Used while the room sensor is unavailable.
data_description.contacts: The unit switches off while one of them stays open.
data_description.contacts_inverted: Turn on if your contacts are on when closed (for example Loxone inputs).
data_description.schedule: The unit only runs while this schedule is on. Leave empty to run all the time.

error.underlying_in_use: Another SteadyRoom device already controls this air conditioner.
error.fallback_is_room_sensor: The fallback sensor must differ from the room sensor.

abort.already_configured: This air conditioner is already controlled by SteadyRoom.
